blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Select all the numbers that are solutions of x less than negative one, or x greater than or equal to three.
blocks.display: Select all the numbers that are solutions of x < −1 or x ≥ 3.

blocks.text: Negative one. No: negative one is not less than negative one, and it is not three or more.
Negative two. Yes: negative two is less than negative one.
Zero. No: zero is in the gap, neither less than negative one nor three or more.
Three. Yes: three is greater than or equal to three, so the circle at three is closed.
Ten. Yes: ten is three or more.
Negative two, three and ten are solutions. Negative one and zero are in the gap between the two rays.
